content: चैत्य {%a.%} Relating to a pile. .{@-त्यः@} The individual soul. .{@-त्यम्@} .²1 The ant-hill; नागहेतोः सुपर्णेन चैत्यमुन्मथितं यथा <ls>Rām. 4. 19. 24</ls>. .²2 A pile of stones forming a landmark. .²3 A monument, tomb-stone. .²4 A sacrificial shed; देवस्थानेषु चैत्येषु नागानामालयेषु च <ls>Mb. 3. 190. 67</ls>; कच्चिच्चैत्यशतैर्जुष्टः <ls>Rām. 2. 100. 43</ls>; प्रासादगोपुरसभाचैत्यदेवगृहादिषु <ls>Bhāg. 9. 11. 27</ls>. .²5 A place of religious worship, altar, sanctuary. .²6 A temple. .²7 A reflection. .²8 A religious fig-tree or any tree growing by the side of streets; चैत्ययूपाङ्किता भूमिर्यस्येयं सवनाकरा <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 229</ls>; <ls>Me. 23</ls> (रथ्यावृक्ष <ls>Malli.</ls>)
